Going through a family law issue can be a stressful and emotional time, but with the right legal support, it can be manageable. The Harris County Family Law Center is here to provide you with the guidance and representation you need to navigate the legal process and achieve a favorable outcome.

Introduction to Harris County Family Law Center

The Harris County Family Law Center is a dedicated legal resource for families in Harris County and the surrounding areas. Our team of experienced family law attorneys is committed to providing quality legal services to individuals and families facing family law issues. Whether you're going through a divorce, child custody dispute, domestic violence issue, property division, paternity, or adoption, we're here to help.

Understanding Family Law Services

Family law encompasses a wide range of legal issues, including divorce proceedings, child custody and support, domestic violence and abuse, property division, paternity, and adoption. Each of these areas of law requires a thorough understanding of the law and the legal system, as well as a compassionate and understanding approach to the emotional toll that family law matters can take.

Divorce proceedings

A divorce is a legal process that dissolves a marriage. The divorce process can be complex, but with the help of a knowledgeable family law attorney, it can be manageable.

Child custody and support

Child custody and support are two of the most emotionally charged areas of family law. When parents are unable to agree on a custody arrangement, the court will make a determination based on the best interests of the child.

Domestic violence and abuse

Domestic violence is a serious issue that affects millions of people each year. If you or someone you love is a victim of domestic violence, it's important to seek help as soon as possible.

Property division

Property division is a process that occurs during a divorce where the marital assets and debts are divided between the two spouses. This process can be complex and requires a thorough understanding of the law and the financial situation of the parties involved.

Paternity and adoption

Paternity and adoption are legal processes that establish the legal relationship between a parent and child. Whether you're trying to establish paternity or looking to adopt a child, it's important to have a knowledgeable family law attorney on your side.
